## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem, the resulting behavior, and any related issue.

## Verification

List the commands you ran, their results, the tested revision, and your platform
and toolchain. Distinguish simulator, native-runtime, bounded-model, and Lean
checks. Record skipped checks and material failures, including what changed
before any successful retry.

## Scope and compatibility

Describe any protocol, storage-format, API, or proof-assumption changes. State
remaining limits and risks. For documentation-only changes, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused purpose and relevant regression coverage.
- [ ] Verification claims match the commands actually run.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the changed behavior.
- [ ] Generated binaries, temporary data, and unrelated local reports are excluded.
- [ ] External sources and applicable license notices are identified.
